title: I replaced my entire team with AI for one week

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: I replaced my entire team with AI for one week — and it worked better than I ever imagined.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This is the future of work, and it's happening right now.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: I used AI to handle project management, client calls, and even coding.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The AI tool I used had real-time language translation and auto-generated reports.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: My clients didn’t notice a difference — and my productivity doubled.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The key takeaway? AI isn’t replacing humans — it’s supercharging them.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Have you tried using AI to boost your workflow? Let me know in the comments.

caption_text: I replaced my entire team with AI for one week
